minor.issue: Race with immediately-preceding POST /manual-entry: if the UI's grn.version state hasn't updated (React re-render after manual-entry response), the DN save PATCH is sent with the pre-manual-entry version and gets 409 STATE_CHANGED. Reproduced once on first attempt (GRN-00002, dn.number stayed empty, start-count then rejected with 400 'Nomor surat jalan wajib diisi'). Second and third attempts (with a wait after manual-entry) worked cleanly. Consider making patch_dn tolerate ±1 version bump within the same status window, or ensure GrnReviewPanel awaits the manual-entry response before enabling grn-dn-save.

integration_issues.issue: If user clicks Save before the manual-entry mutation resolves and re-renders the panel with the new grn.version, PATCH /dn returns 409 STATE_CHANGED and dn.number is silently NOT persisted. UI shows no error toast (only console 409). Downstream Mulai hitung fails with 400. Test needs a ~1s wait between the two actions to reproduce success; a real user typing DN quickly after clicking 'Isi manual' hits this.

action_items: Harden DN save race: either (a) block the grn-dn-save button until the manual-entry POST resolves and grn.version has advanced, or (b) surface a friendly error toast in GrnReviewPanel when PATCH /dn returns 409 STATE_CHANGED so the user knows to retry.
Consider cancelling / cleaning up the leftover in-Tinjau-SJ GRN KSC/GRN-00002 (from a failed first attempt during this iteration) for hygiene, though it does not block any flow.

Optional: expose grn-count-add-1 as more specific undo attribution (currently undo buttons rely on order — the last-added roll id was correctly identified but relying on order is fragile for future automated tests).
critical_code_review_comments: GrnReviewPanel.jsx save() at line 23 uses grn.version captured at closure-render time. Because manual-entry advances version (0→1) via a separate mutation, the subsequent DN patch can race. Recommendation: after each mutation, guard actions with a per-panel busy flag or requery grn before allowing the next status-transition-adjacent write.

goods_receipt_service.py::cas() correctly returns 409 STATE_CHANGED on version/status mismatch — behavior is right; the UX gap is that the frontend does not surface this to the user in the DN header form.
Blind-count UI contract holds: warehouse@ opening the GRN sees only Hitung tab and grn-blind-note, and declared totals (250 / 2 roll) are stripped in public_view — verified in DOM.
start_count enforcement is correct: 400 'Nomor surat jalan wajib diisi.' fired when dn.number was empty (from the CAS-losing DN save), catching the upstream failure.

Close-cascade produces expected supply-chain: grn-close-results reports 'terposting · tugas sisa 150 dibuat' and a fresh WMS remainder task appears for KSC/PO-00014 (0/150 yard) — verified in warehouse Barang Masuk.

If the main agent hardens GrnReviewPanel to await manual-entry resolution before enabling grn-dn-save (or shows 409 toast), that specific flake goes away.
rca of the issue: GrnReviewPanel.jsx captures grn.version in the save() closure. After POST /manual-entry, the parent state should refresh grn (bumping version 0→1) before the DN patch. When a Playwright test (or a fast human) triggers grn-dn-save while the parent re-render hasn't propagated the new version, PATCH /dn is issued with expected_version=0, which no longer matches the CAS filter — server responds 409 STATE_CHANGED and dn.number is silently discarded. Downstream, grn-start-count rejects with 400 NOT_READY 'Nomor surat jalan wajib diisi.' Mitigation used in test: wait ~1.5s after manual-entry click and re-wait for the DN input to be visible before filling. Production mitigation: disable grn-dn-save until the manual-entry mutation resolves (or bump expected_version tolerance).
